body:
weight: light
tier: 1
charter: C1

Build `factory/bin/mirror.sh` and `factory/bin/post-merge.sh` per SPEC-v0.2 'Decisions baked in' and ADR-0002 (docs/adr/0002-adlc-sharded-ticket-store.md). The ADLC sharded store under .adlc/tickets/ is the source of truth, written only from main; Issues are the display. Labels are set only by the mirror (write access), so nothing a stranger files becomes claimable without the desk.

Acceptance criteria (verified by `make test`, offline, with the fake gh recording every call):
1. `mirror.sh` reads every open ticket with `npx -y @adlc/cli@1.12.0 ticket list --json`, parses the body header (`weight:`, `tier:`, `charter:`), and creates or updates one Issue per ticket with labels `w:<weight>`, `tier:<n>`, plus `ready` only when the ticket's gate record (`.adlc/manifest.d` entries for spec-lint, coldstart, merge-forecast) is clean, else `needs-desk`; verified by tests/test_mirror.sh cases 'creates', 'updates-idempotent', 'ready-only-when-gated'.
2. The Issue body carries the ticket id and `Depends-on:` lines from the ticket's edges; verified by case 'depends-on-lines'.
3. `post-merge.sh` finds the ticket ids named by `Ticket:` trailers in the merged commits since the last run, runs `adlc ticket complete <id> --write --authorize` for each, appends one line per verified finding to factory/ledger/findings.jsonl, and refuses to run anywhere but a checkout of main (`git symbolic-ref --short HEAD` = main) with exit 2; verified by tests/test_post_merge.sh cases 'completes', 'refuses-off-main'.
4. shellcheck -S warning clean (`make lint`).

Depends on T1 (lock naming) and T2.
title: Implement the mirror and post-merge jobs: ticket store to Issues, completion only from main
